name: Breadcrumbs
description: The path from the top of the site to the current page, as links. Use BreadcrumbItem for each step; the last one is the current page.

children.description: BreadcrumbItem elements, from the top level down to the current page.

label.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Translate it for other languages.

separator.description: The mark between steps. Use BreadcrumbItem's own `separator` prop for any other mark.

isDisabled.description: Disables every link in the trail.

requirements: A navigation landmark with an accessible name, containing an ordered list of links
The last item is the current page: aria-current="page", and it cannot be followed (it has no href and is aria-disabled)
Separators are decorative (aria-hidden), so they are not read out
Links have a visible focus ring
A collapsed trail keeps the hidden steps in a menu, reached by a button that is named (for example "Show hidden pages") and opens with Enter or Space
screenReader: Announced as a navigation landmark named Breadcrumbs, with a list of N items
The final item is announced as the current page

use_when: Sites or apps with more than two levels of hierarchy
Telling people where they are and how to go back up
avoid_when: A flat site with one level: no trail is needed
Showing the steps someone has taken: use a stepper
anti_patterns: Making the current page a link to itself
Using breadcrumbs instead of the main navigation
Hiding the trail from screen readers with aria-hidden
